name: DICOM Mobile Viewer
subtitle: CT, MRI & X-ray scans offline
promo: Open your hospital CD or scan files and scroll through CT and MRI slices. Private and offline: nothing is uploaded.
description:
Open your hospital CD or scan files and look through them on your iPhone: scroll CT and MRI slices, adjust brightness and measure. Everything stays on your device.

Try the built-in sample scan in one tap. No account, no ads, no uploads.

KEY FEATURES:
• Fast volume navigation: smoothly scroll through hundreds of CT and MRI slices.
• Scout / localizer sync: reference lines show where each slice sits across axial, sagittal and coronal planes. Tap the scout to jump to a slice.
• Two views side by side (e.g. scout next to axial, sagittal next to coronal) with linked locators.
• Measurements: calibrated distances, elliptical ROI stats (area, mean, min/max HU, SD) and Cobb angles.
• Wide DICOM support: uncompressed, RLE, JPEG Baseline/Lossless, JPEG 2000 and JPEG-LS, multi-frame series and cine playback.
• 100% private and offline: all parsing and rendering happens on your device. No accounts, no analytics, no tracking, no cloud uploads.
• Flexible import: Files app, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, AirDrop, whole folders or .zip archives.

DISCLAIMER:
DICOM Mobile is for personal reference, research and education. It is not intended for primary diagnosis or treatment planning.
